concerns.text: FR-001 (Spec) mandates NOAA/PRISM data. Plan deviates to Daymet. Task T005c4 (Document Plan Deviation) is marked [ ] (unchecked/empty). Without this ratified deviation document, the primary climate task T005c1_climate cannot legally proceed to the Daymet fallback, leaving FR-001 unimplemented and the pipeline blocked.

US-1 Independent Test requires verifying the pipeline on a subset. Task T013 (Integration Test for Data Ingestion Flow) is marked [ ] (unchecked). Without this test, the 'Independent Test' acceptance criteria for US-1 are not covered by a task.

US-1 and FR-002/003 require the preprocessing pipeline (filtering, grid aggregation, phenology metrics). Task T015b (Implement Preprocessing Pipeline) is marked [ ] (unchecked). The core data transformation logic is missing a task execution status.

FR-003 and US-1 Edge Cases require provenance mapping (linking processed rows to checklist_id). Task T016 (Generate Provenance Mapping) is marked [ ] (unchecked). This leaves the 'Ecological Data Provenance' (Constitution VI) requirement unimplemented.
FR-004 and US-2 require fitting GAMMs with specific random effects. Task T023a_gamm_gp is marked [ ] (unchecked). The core modeling engine is not covered by an active task.

FR-005 and US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1 mandate 10,000 permutation shuffles. Task T025d (Permutation Test for GAMM Coefficients) is marked [ ] (unchecked). The statistical validation requirement is unimplemented.
FR-006 and US-3 require computing weekly centroids on a Riemannian manifold. Task T030 is marked [ ] (unchecked). The spatial analysis foundation is missing.
FR-005 and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 1 mandate 10,000 permutation shuffles for route shifts. Task T031c_permutation is marked [ ] (unchecked). The route shift validation is unimplemented.
FR-007 requires generating 95% CIs for model predictions. Task T033a1 (Generate Phenology Confidence Intervals) is marked [ ] (unchecked). The uncertainty quantification requirement is unimplemented.

SC-001 through SC-005 require measuring and reporting success criteria. Task T043 (Calculate and Report All Success Criteria) is marked [ ] (unchecked). The project cannot validate its own success without this task.

SC-002, SC-003, SC-004 have [deferred] targets in Spec. Plan provides fallbacks. Task T043a (Define Success Criteria Targets) is marked [ ] (unchecked). The mechanism to resolve deferred targets is unimplemented.

SC-005 (Runtime) and the conflict between 10k shuffles and 6h limit require a specific optimization strategy. Task T053 (Optimize Permutation Tests) is marked [X] (checked) but the description implies a complex logic that may not be fully realized if the underlying permutation tasks (T025d, T031c) are not implemented. However, the primary gap is the unchecked status of the permutation tasks themselves.

Task T005c5 (Pre-Execution Ordering Validator) is marked [ ] (unchecked). While the task exists, its unchecked status means the validation of the task file itself (a meta-requirement) is not covered. Additionally, the task description references 'T013, T021' as verify tasks, but T013 is unchecked, creating a logical gap in the validator's scope if it expects those tasks to exist as 'producers'.
